subject: GGIR Cut Points - Excluding Light or Vigorous Activity

messages.author: 183e408b6834885e
messages.subject: GGIR Cut Points - Excluding Light or Vigorous Activity
parts:
Good afternoon! 

I am trying to use the Migueles 2021 Actigraph non-dominant wrist (L:18, M:60, V:NA) or the Bammann 2021 non dominant wrist (M:100, V:254) cut points with my data. For some reason, when I try to run my data with the Bammann, I am still getting output for light intensity activity. I have tried a few things including threshold.lig = Inf, threshold.lig = NA, and deleting this row but I am still getting light intensity activity values on my csv output. 

Are there any tips to excluding this correctly so that light intensity (Bammann) and vigorous intensity (Migueles) are excluded from output? Do I need to have multiple raw folders to re-process the data? I continuously get the same output for each of these and I'm not sure why. 

Thank you for your help! Any guidance is greatly appreciated.

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] GGIR Cut Points - Excluding Light or Vigorous Activity
parts:
Hi Ariel,

GGIR always calculates all intensity levels based on the assumption that humans consume energy on a continuous scale. We are not robots who either off (inactive) or on (moderately or vigorously active). I think you misunderstood the publications: The fact that they did not propose thresholds (cut-points) for all levels does not mean those levels do not exist, it is just that the authors did not have the data to justify proposing those thresholds.

I see two options:
  1. Explore what might be a reasonable threshold value based on the thresholds you find for other/similar populations. For example, in a slightly younger or older age group? Next, interpret the estimates for that threshold carefully.
  2. Give threshold.lig the same value as threshold.mod, which will then result in 0 minutes spent in light PA. Similarly, if you specify threshold.vig = Inf you should get zero minutes spent in vigorous PA. However, I think you will then have to acknowledge in your reporting that inactivity in your results equals light and inactivity combined and moderate equals moderate and vigorous combined.

Best, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
